jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: About Hud Hud is building Runtime Intelligence for AI-Native Engineering.AI raised software throughput, but delivery stability did not follow. Coding now moves at agent speed, while review, merge, deploy, and production verification are still largely manual. Hud is built to overcome that release bottleneck.Our runtime code sensor captures function-level production behavior and learns a baseline for every function. Hud brings that runtime context into every release: low-risk PRs can be validated against real production evidence, deployments are checked against production baselines, regressions are flagged within minutes, and the evidence needed to fix them is sent directly to AI agents.Hud is trusted by leading engineering teams including monday.com, Drata, Axonius, Cyera, and others. We're building toward a world of agentic coding and agentic release - where software can ship fast and ship fearless. About the Role This is a customer-facing technical role combining solutions engineering, technical pre-sales, and hands-on implementation.You will work alongside Account Executives throughout the sales process - from technical discovery and demos through evaluations, integration, and adoption. You'll help customers understand where Hud fits, prove its value in their environment, remove technical blockers, and move opportunities forward.Hud gives engineers and AI agents runtime context into how code behaves under real traffic, load, and failures. Our customers often operate complex production environments, so you'll need enough technical depth to understand their architecture, troubleshoot integrations, and earn the trust of senior engineers.At the same time, this role is not only about solving technical problems. You'll help shape evaluations, define success criteria, navigate stakeholders, and connect Hud's capabilities to the customer's priorities.You'll also bring what you learn in the field back into Product and Engineering, helping us improve the product, demos, integrations, and overall customer experience.This is an opportunity to join Hud early, help define the Solutions Engineering function, and work with a high-caliber team tackling some of the most interesting challenges emerging from AI-driven software development.If you enjoy being technical while working closely with customers, sales, product, and engineering, this role is for you. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Runtime Internals
jobs.description: About the Role We’re building a runtime code sensor that operates where most tools don’t: inside running applications. Our goal is to give engineers and AI agents real-time, high-fidelity visibility into how code actually behaves in production – under real load, real traffic, and real failures.This role blends deep systems engineering with applied research. You’ll dive into runtime internals, explore undocumented behavior, design low-overhead instrumentation, and turn research insights into production-grade components that safely run in customer environments. One day you might analyze GC or JIT behavior; the next, design tracing mechanisms that survive real-world distributed systems.If you get excited about runtime internals, enjoy breaking (and fixing) complex systems, think like both a researcher and a production engineer, and care deeply about performance, safety, and correctness – you’ll feel right at home here. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for engineers who want to ship technology that engineers actually trust to run in their most critical services. Experience 5+ years of hands-on research or development roles.Deep expertise in at least one runtime (Node.js, Python, or Java/JVM), including understanding of internals (event loop, GC, tracing hooks, bytecode/JIT, etc.).Hands-on experience building in-process production components (SDKs, agents, profilers, monitoring/security tools) that must be safe, stable, and backward-compatible.Strong performance engineering skills – profiling CPU/memory, avoiding overhead, understanding how instrumentation affects runtime behavior.Defensive engineering mindset – experience designing systems that fail-open, degrade gracefully, protect the host application, and never introduce instability.Track record debugging production issues (latency, memory leaks, regressions, deadlocks) in real-world distributed systems.Solid understanding of modern backend architectures – experience with microservices, distributed systems, async and event-driven patterns, containers/orchestration (Docker/K8s), cloud runtimes, and the performance or reliability challenges they introduce.Proven ability to ship stable, resilient, maintainable systems in production. Engineering Excellence / Mindset Ability to anticipate technical risks, identify bottlenecks, and drive long-term engineering improvements.Takes ownership of code quality, documentation, reliability, and observability.Comfortable working with product teams to balance technical trade-offs with user and business needs.Autonomous and proactive; capable of mentoring others or leading technical initiatives. Bonus Points Background in security agents, observability tools, or other components deployed directly into customer environments.Experience with APM agents, JVM agents, Python tracing, V8 internals, or other instrumentation/profiling frameworks.Experience with telemetry systems (metrics, tracing, logging) including batching, rate-limiting, and safe data collection.Familiarity with sampling techniques, bytecode manipulation, eBPF, or low-overhead tracing.Exposure to safety-critical or high-throughput environments where reliability and minimal overhead are mandatory.Contributions to open-source instrumentation, tracing, or internals-related projects. Requirements This is a full-time on-site position located in Tel Aviv.Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment is essential.
